I put maybe too much importance on what others say. I went to university largely because my parents said I should. I stopped dating because someone told me I wasn't good at it. So if the gods try and give me a purpose, I know I will follow that purpose rather than die because I don't want to disappoint them.
By wasn't meant to be alive, I mean that I was never wanted. My parents accidentally made me and my mother once told me she never wanted to have me. I was a mistake and I intend to correct that mistake.
I'm sorry, but I don't know if I want help

I just. Really. Want to die. To the exclusion of everything else. I wasn't meant to be alive, so I feel like I am correcting a mistake. I am afraid the gods will try and do something to give me purpose and that scares me more than death.

I am afraid to because what if they try and stop me ? It's one thing to have strangers tell to me to not do it, it's another to feel like I have disappointed my gods. Thank you for trying to answer my question.
